# Salary & Standing
Corporate Standing is the Company's opinion of you, expressed as a number. It goes up. It rarely goes down on its own.
- What it is: a currency tracked on your Season Ledger. Standing is earned, never simply given, and it spends at Requisitions Anonymous and elsewhere.
- Where to find it: there is no single "wallet" screen — Standing is shown wherever it matters (the Requisitions Anonymous console when you can afford something, your Season Ledger entry, and a confirmation whenever you are awarded some).
- How to earn it, in rough order of reliability: - Complete work orders from the Contracts Board and deliver the goods to the fulfillment dropbox — the single most reliable source. - Complete a bounty claim the Liability Board judges favorably. - Simply finish a shift in good standing: some rounds pay a modest career-rank salary at round end, scaled by your rank and tenure, regardless of what else you did.
- Steps to first success: browse the Contracts Board, pick a work order matching what you already have or can make, deliver it, and watch your Standing confirmation. That confirmation is the receipt — if you were awarded Standing, you will be told exactly how much and why, immediately.
- Standing accumulated toward your career total (not just this round) is what feeds your Season Ledger rank — see that page next.
